name: FRONTKN
recent: Frontken 在 2026 年 11 月公布季度业绩，净利按年增长 71%，并获 EPF 增持。同期，公司宣布董事局与提名委员会人事变动，以及台湾子公司以 RM118.16mil 收购工业土地与厂房。
notable: EPF 增持 Frontken 680 万股。
Frontken 台湾子公司以 RM118.16mil 收购工业土地与厂房。
Frontken 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利按年增长 71%。
risks: Chiu Yoong Chian Gerald 自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起卸任提名委员会非独立非执行成员。
Ng Wai Pin 出现董事局变动。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收为 RM181.04mil，按年增长 15.7%，按季下降 3.1%；净利为 RM57.25mil，按年增长 71.0%，按季增长 20.0%；净利率为 31.6%，高于上一季度的 25.5%。

recent_en: Frontken reported quarterly earnings in November 2026 with net profit up 71% year-on-year and saw EPF raise its stake. During the same period, the company announced board and nomination committee changes, and a Taiwan subsidiary acquired industrial land and factory buildings for RM118.16 million.
notable_en: EPF raised its stake in Frontken by 6.8 million shares.
Frontken's Taiwan subsidiary acquired industrial land and factory buildings for RM118.16 million.
Frontken announced 3Q FY2026 results with net profit up 71% year-on-year.
risks_en: Chiu Yoong Chian Gerald ceased as Non-Independent Non-Executive Member of the Nomination Committee effective 1 January 2027.
There was a boardroom change involving Ng Wai Pin.
earnings_en: 3Q FY2026 revenue was RM181.04 million, up 15.7% year-on-year and down 3.1% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM57.25 million, up 71.0% year-on-year and 20.0% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 31.6%, higher than 25.5% in the previous quarter.
